Who we are

Every great story begins with someone who sees it before anyone else does. Njama Creations is that eye. We shoot, we direct and we light the world the way it feels, so your wedding, your brand, your music and your people look the way they matter.

What we do

Four crafts.
One vision.

Portraits, weddings, events, products and brands.

A frame you will still stop and look at in ten years. Natural light, honest emotion, nothing stiff.

Weddings, events, brand films, music videos and social reels.

We capture the day as it moves: the laugh, the speech, the long walk, the sound of the room.

Concept, script, casting, locations and what happens on set.

Before the camera rolls, the idea has to be right. We shape it, guide everyone in front of the lens and keep the story on track.

Lighting, lenses, camera movement and colour.

This is the look and feel. The same scene can be cold, warm, tense or tender, and we choose which one you get.

How it works

From idea to final cut

1

We talk

You tell us the story, the date and the feeling you want.

2

We plan

Locations, shot list, light, team and timing, all agreed before the day.

3

We shoot

Calm on set. You enjoy the moment while we work around you.

4

We deliver

Edited, graded and ready to share, print or play on a big screen.

A few words

Said straight to you

To couples

Your day moves fast. We will be the quiet ones in the corner, catching the glance you did not know you gave, so you can live it now and watch it for the rest of your life.

To brands

People forget what you sell. They remember how it made them feel. We make the picture, the film and the feeling match the product you are proud of.

To everyone with a story

You do not need a huge budget to look like a big name. You need someone who can see the light in what you already have. That is where we start.
